newsitem.title: UK: Britain says would not normally return Zaireans.
newsitem.headline: Britain says would not normally return Zaireans.

text.p: Britain said on Friday that the situation in Zaire had now become so dangerous that it would be easier for people from the central African country who claimed asylum.

"I have decided to declare that that country has undergone such a fundamental change in circumstances that I would not normally order the return of a person to that country for the time being," interior minister Jack Straw said.

Straw said in a written answer to a parliamentary question that a Zairean applying for asylum would automatically be eligible to claim welfare benefits while waiting for their application to be considered.

The Conservative government which was defeated at the May 1 election changed asylum laws to prevent most asylum seekers claiming social security payments unless they made their application for asylum immediately on reaching Britain.
Rebel forces under Laurent Kabila are currently advancing on the Zairean capital Kinshasa in an attempt to claim complete victory in their battle against President Mobutu Sese Seko.
